_comment: Synthetic G36 VAV fleet (generator g36_vav_fleet, camber/datasets/_synthetic_g36_vav_fleet.py; 0.105, #144) -> CAMBER Role mapping for one air handler. Every column is CAMBER's own: OAT the outdoor temperature in F, SF_STS the supply fan's run status (1 running), OCC the building's occupancy point (1 occupied), SAT and SAT_SP the supply-air temperature and its trim-and-respond setpoint in F, SAT_REQ the SAT reset requests the controller summed from its six boxes, DSP and DSP_SP the duct static pressure and its trim-and-respond setpoint in in. w.c., DSP_REQ the static-pressure reset requests. The scenario column selects one air handler per ingest run and is not a point.
